{
  "name": "think-meter",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Brings the terminal's turn timer to the desktop app: how long each answer took, split into wait, thinking, writing and tools, with tok/s, a live thinking timer and /think-stats",
  "author": {
    "name": "Huuuuung",
    "url": "https://github.com/Huuuuung"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Huuuuung/think-meter",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Huuuuung/think-meter",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "mod",
    "thinking",
    "latency",
    "tokens-per-second",
    "metrics"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "showTurnLine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the line under each answer",
      "description": "Print thinking time, output tokens and tok/s under each answer",
      "default": true
    },
    "liveSpinner": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Live thinking timer",
      "description": "Show elapsed thinking time beside the spinner while Claude thinks",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
